notes: This manifest is the canonical list of automated suites for Dungeoncrawler.
If the product also has language-native unit tests (e.g., PHPUnit), they can be included as suites here, but the PASS/FAIL contract must remain consistent.

suites.label: Clan Dagger — Dwarven Starting Equipment (drush ev unit tests)
suites.notes: Verified via drush ev (no Playwright suite yet — drush-ev approach is authoritative until Playwright env is provisioned). Tests cover: TC-001 catalog JSON, TC-002 Dwarf auto-grant, TC-003 item flags, TC-004 sell taboo block, TC-008 non-Dwarf exclusion, TC-009 distinct instances, TC-010 drop no-taboo, TC-011 location change no-taboo, TC-013 graceful fail, TC-014 server-side grant, TC-015 server-side taboo, TC-016 GM override. TC-005/006/007 (combat) deferred: requires dc-cr-encounter-rules completion. TC-012 FAIL: duplicate grant prevention not enforced (see BLOCK note).

suites.label: Character Leveling and Advancement — E2E (drush ev unit tests)
suites.notes: Stage-0 activated 2026-04-05. Playwright test scripts pending implementation (19 TCs defined in features/dc-cr-character-leveling/03-test-plan.md). Until scripts exist, use drush ev inline PHP for TC-001/007/009/010/013/014 (trigger, idempotency, max-level, milestone, non-existent char, structured error). TC-015 (concurrency) and TC-008 (persistence) require live env + PHPUnit. Routes: 8 level-up routes + 1 milestone route registered in dungeoncrawler_content.routing.yml. Admin routes gate on 'administer dungeoncrawler content'; player routes gate on _character_access:TRUE + _csrf_request_header_mode:TRUE. ACL coverage: api-character-entity-routes rule in qa-permissions.json (ignore on parametrized paths). Requires composer install in /home/ubuntu/forseti.life/sites/dungeoncrawler before any drush commands can run.
